parsed.title: Paywall Decline Guest Task Pass
parsed.oneLiner: Offer a single guest task execution via a rewarded mini-game after a user declines the account setup paywall.
parsed.trigger: User taps Maybe later on Create Account Sheet and returns to Services Tab without subscribing.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guest users without an account who have dismissed the Create Account Sheet paywall.

offer.title: Try One Task for Free
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to run one assistant task without creating an account.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Only surfaces after an explicit paywall decline as a guest-friendly fallback. Strictly capped at one single execution per day to ensure users with ongoing utility needs still convert to a premium subscription.

kpis.primary: Luzia+ subscription conversion rate among paywall decliners over 28 days
guardrails: Overall D7 and D30 user retention non-inferiority margin within -1%
Total paid subscription revenue per user (non-inferiority margin -3% relative)
kpis.holdout: Randomized user-level 10% holdout group ineligible for rewarded guest fallback passes for 28 days

risks: Users with infrequent task needs may defer signing up indefinitely if their daily task is satisfied.
Premium tool execution and model costs might outpace ad revenue in lower-eCPM regions.

evidence.quote: Sign up so Luzia can start doing things for you.
